note: v0.11.22: what tools/leftovers.mjs reports but stays on purpose, with a reason each. "name*" matches a prefix. Kinds: files, functions, testOnly, css, flagsUnread, flagsUnset, items, storage, markers, choices. New entries only with the owner's ok. Since v0.11.23 the check is strict: a finding not on this list fails the full and the quick check (choices stay log only).

files.project/*: the project docs (named only in other docs, which the file scan skips)
files..github/*: GitHub runs the workflows by itself
files.saves/*: tests/saves.test.mjs loads every file in the folder
files.tools/bg.py: by hand: makes the background crops in art/bg (handover, Files)

testOnly.setDryClone: test hook: the lean = full copy comparison in tests/tasks.test.mjs
testOnly.START_SCENE: the first scene, exported for the tests
testOnly.taskState: test accessor: tests/tasks.test.mjs reads familiarity and the queue through it
